doc: f outside [0, 1] is not clipped: f = 1.5 extrapolates past back (p (1 - f) + back f = -0.5 p + 1.5 back) before the normalization, and f = -0.5 the other way (second output). float32 points. Tolerance is the golden float32 default. Arguments: p and back (inputs, direction vectors of shape (..., 3)) and f (params): q = normalize(p (1 - f) + back f), with normalize(v) = v / ||v|| over the last axis (sphere.py) and NO epsilon guard: a zero vector gives 0 / 0 = NaN, not 0. The blend and the norm run in the dtype of the inputs (float32 vectors: float32 norm). Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 1.2e-7; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 2.4e-7 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is 14x the larger of the two spreads.
